desc: Experience the perfect fusion of precision engineering and timeless style with the Bergara Platinum Stalker rifle. Designed for the discerning shooter who demands both performance and aesthetics, this rifle is built to excel in the field and at the range. The Platinum Stalker is chambered in the formidable .7mm Remington Magnum, delivering the power and range needed for challenging hunts and long-distance target shooting. The rifle's 22-inch fluted steel barrel, paired with the advanced Omni muzzle brake, ensures each shot is both accurate and comfortable, with significantly reduced recoil for faster follow-up shots. The striking grey laminate wood Boyds Heritage stock not only provides exceptional durability but also adds a touch of classic elegance to this modern precision rifle. Whether you're pursuing game in rugged terrain or perfecting your shot at the range, the Bergara Platinum Stalker is your trusted companion for consistent, reliable performance.
